item.title: Show HN: Sous.bio – your sous chef in the lab
item.summary: Recording science is a huge bottleneck. In my previous role at a synbio start-up, there was so much we want to do with result --data driven decisions on experiments, analysis on yield from experimental params, -- but could not as collecting coherent data was hard. The data schema was hard to design, legacy lab instruments was hard to pipe data through, and there's no immediate value to provide the scientists themselves. Sous is an AI-enabled platform to accelerate this process and allow scientists to focus on the science. We are currently focused on the SynBio domain but our mission is to help make science more efficient! Love to connect if you are interested.
